prompt: Write a single, self-contained prompt for a text-to-image model that has never heard of Chinese memes, so that it draws a giraffe version of the "大笑奶龙" (Laughing Nailong / 奶蛙) meme. Output only the prompt.
answer: Draw a square reaction image of a plump golden-yellow baby giraffe caught at the peak of a belly laugh. Give it the soft, pear-shaped body, stubby arms, and pillowy cheeks of a little cartoon dinosaur. A gently stretched neck, two short brown-tipped horns, leaf-shaped ears, and a few caramel patches make it unmistakably a giraffe. Show it from the belly up in a slight three-quarter view, leaning back with its chin lifted. Push the cheeks up until the tiny eyes squeeze into curved slits. Stretch the broad muzzle into a huge open grin, with upturned corners, a deep burgundy mouth, and a pink tongue visible at the bottom. Its little forehooves curl toward its jiggling belly. Render it like a frame from a playful 3D cartoon, with smooth rounded shapes, soft lighting, and a plain pale background. Let the laughing face fill the frame. No lettering or watermark.
